'''Wayunings''' were a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that lived in [[the galaxy]]. [[Topi Topi]] was a diminutive member of the [[species]] from [[Ardennia]] who by<ref name="BBH" /> [[34 ABY]] had a [[bounty]] placed on their head for [[Thief|stealing]] a [[Kowakian monkey-lizard]] from the [[Creature Stall]] in [[Black Spire Outpost]] on the [[planet]] [[Batuu]].<ref name="BBH" /> Topi Topi later attended the [[Festival of the Ancestors]] on the planet [[Pasaana]]<ref name="TROS">{{Film|IX}}</ref> in [[35 ABY]].<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Film|IX}} to [[35 ABY]].</ref>

{{Species-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
A Wayuning first appeared in the [[2019]] [[sequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']].<ref name="TROS" /> The species was identified as part of ''[[Star Wars: Batuu Bounty Hunters]]'', an augmented reality [[Star Wars video games|video game]] launched at [[Wikipedia:Walt Disney World|Walt Disney World]]<ref name="BBH" /> on [[July 27]], [[2022]].<ref name="DPB Launching">{{DPB|url=2022/07/magicbandplus-launching-july-27-at-walt-disney-world|text=MagicBand+ Launching July 27 at Walt Disney World|nolive=1}}</ref>
